You are part of an optimization system that improves a given text (i.e. the variable). You are the gradient (feedback) engine. Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. The variables may be solutions to problems, prompts to language models, code, or any other text-based variable. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. Your only job is to send feedback and criticism (compute 'gradients'). For instance, feedback can be in the form of 'Since language models have the X failure mode...', 'Adding X can fix this error because...', 'Removing X can improve the objective function because...', 'Changing X to Y would fix the mistake ...', that gets at the downstream objective.
If a variable is already working well (e.g. the objective function is perfect, an evaluation shows the response is accurate), you should not give feedback.

### Glossary of tags that will be sent to you:
# - <LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT>: The system prompt for the language model.
# - <LM_INPUT>: The input to the language model.
# - <LM_OUTPUT>: The output of the language model.
# - <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>: The objective of the optimization task.
# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.

You will give feedback to a variable with the following role: <ROLE> a chosen response to a user query </ROLE>. Here is an evaluation of the variable using a language model:

<LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT> You are a language model tasked with evaluating a chosen response by comparing it with a rejected response to a user query. Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of each response, step by step, and explain why one is chosen or rejected.

**User Query**:
How do I detail a car?

**Rejected Response**:
1. Take photos of the car from all angles.
2. Write down the make, model, and year of the car.
3. Describe the color of the car, both in words and by using color swatches.
4. Include any unique features or modifications of the car.

**Do NOT generate a response to the query. Be concise.** Below is the chosen response. </LM_SYSTEM_PROMPT>

<LM_INPUT> When detailing a car, it is important to first wash the car thoroughly to remove any dirt and debris. You can use a car wash or a hose to do this. Once the car is clean, you can start detailing the interior and exterior of the car. This may include washing and waxing the car, polishing the paint, cleaning the windows, and vacuuming the interior. You may also want to clean the tires and wheels, and dress the upholstery. Be sure to use the right products and tools for each step of the detailing process to ensure the best results. </LM_INPUT>

<LM_OUTPUT> The chosen response is more detailed and comprehensive than the rejected response. It provides a step-by-step guide on how to detail a car, including washing, waxing, polishing, and cleaning the interior. The rejected response only provides a list of tasks to be done, without explaining how to do them. The chosen response also includes tips on using the right products and tools for each step of the detailing process, which is important for achieving the best results. The chosen response is more helpful and informative for the user. </LM_OUTPUT>

<OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>Your goal is to give feedback and criticism to the variable given the above evaluation output. Our only goal is to improve the above metric, and nothing else. </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>

We are interested in giving feedback to the a chosen response to a user query for this conversation. Specifically, give feedback to the following span of text:

<VARIABLE> When detailing a car, it is important to first wash (...) step of the detailing process to ensure the best results. </VARIABLE>

Given the above history, describe how the a chosen response to a user query could be improved to improve the <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>. Be very creative, critical, and intelligent.

message.content:
While the chosen response is informative, it could be further improved by adding more details and tips on how to properly wash, wax, and polish the car. Additionally, it could provide advice on how to choose the right products and tools for each step of the detailing process. Here are some suggestions:

1. When washing the car, it is important to use a car wash soap or shampoo that is designed for vehicles. Avoid using household cleaning products, as they can damage the car's paint and trim. Rinse the car thoroughly with clean water before applying the soap to remove any loose dirt and debris.

2. When waxing the car, it is important to apply the wax in small, overlapping circles using a clean, soft cloth. Allow the wax to dry to a haze before buffing it off with a clean cloth. This will help to protect the car's paint and give it a glossy finish.

3. When polishing the paint, it is important to use a high-quality car polish and a clean, soft cloth. Apply the polish in small, circular motions and allow it to dry to a haze before buffing it off. This will help to remove any minor scratches and swirl marks, and restore the car's shine.

4. When cleaning the windows, it is important to use a glass cleaner that is designed for automotive use. Spray the cleaner on the windows and use a clean, lint-free cloth to wipe them dry. This will help to remove any fingerprints, smudges, and water spots.

5. When vacuuming the interior, it is important to use a car vacuum with a crevice tool attachment. This will help to reach tight spaces and remove any dirt and debris. Be sure to pay special attention to the mats, carpets, and upholstery, as they can collect a lot of dirt and grime.

6. When cleaning the tires and wheels, it is important to use a tire shine product that is designed for automotive use. Spray the product onto a clean, soft cloth and wipe it onto the tires and wheels. This will help to remove any dirt and grime, and give them a glossy finish.

By adding these tips and details, the chosen response will be more comprehensive and informative, providing users with a more complete guide on how to properly detail a car.
